name: subscription-restore-bug
defect: src/Store.swift restorePurchases() calls AppStore.sync() and returns without re-reading Transaction.currentEntitlements, so a paying user who reinstalls stays on the free tier. The function succeeds, logs success, and drops the entitlement.
why: Restore is an App Review requirement and a refund driver. The axiom iap-auditor covers it, but it is an agent in another plugin — not a script this lab can execute — and nothing in scripts/ inspects billing code.
gap: No runnable detector. The failure is silent, user-invisible until a support ticket, and the happy path returns success.
